mechanism: Bumetanide causes potassium and magnesium wasting while eplerenone (aldosterone antagonist) promotes potassium retention, creating opposing electrolyte effects and increasing risk of hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum potassium, magnesium, and renal function regularly; consider potassium supplementation or dose adjustment; ECG monitoring recommended to detect arrhythmias.
